MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 29% of delays on line(s) A, C, E (1.3x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on A, C, E during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 14 St and the stops before it during the affected hours: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at 42 St-Port Authority Bus Terminal, where A, E trains run ahead of C trains bound for 14 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C, E; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C, E; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so A, E and C slots are offset by at least half a headway at 42 St-Port Authority Bus Terminal
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Inwood-207 St when a gap over 10 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.
